title: Pick List Barcode Scanning broken in v15.76.0

posts.name: Maydo7777
posts.cooked:
We are on the latest ERPNext (v15.76.0) and noticed that barcode scanning in the Pick List no longer works.

This workflow has always worked fine for us in previous versions (we update regularly and were on v15.74 before). Barcode scanning still works correctly in all other documents (Purchase Receipt, Delivery Note, Stock Entry, Transfer, etc.) – only the Pick List is affected.

Since our warehouse operations rely heavily on scanning items into Pick Lists on a daily basis, this issue is a serious blocker for us.

Thanks.

posts.name: Maydo7777
posts.cooked:
The root cause of this bug is a logic change in the get_row_to_modify_on_scan function within the core utility file: erpnext/public/js/utils/barcode_scanner.js.

A new, stricter warehouse_match condition was introduced. The bug is in the else block of this new logic:

// From the new, code
let warehouse_match = true;
if (has_warehouse_field) {
if (warehouse) {
warehouse_match = row[warehouse_field] === warehouse;
} else {
// THIS IS THE BUG!
warehouse_match = !row[warehouse_field];
}
}

This code is executed when no specific warehouse has been scanned beforehand, which is the standard procedure for a Pick List. The line warehouse_match = !row[warehouse_field]; incorrectly requires the warehouse field in the item row to be empty to get a match.

In a Pick List, every item row always has a warehouse assigned. Therefore, row[warehouse_field] is never empty, the condition !row[warehouse_field] is always false, the warehouse_match fails, and the scanner never finds a valid row to update.

posts.name: Peer
posts.cooked:
The change seems to be part of a feature:
feat: enhance barcode scanner to support warehouse scanning (#48865) · frappe/erpnext@227fadc · GitHub

Could this lead you to a workaround?

I didn’t check if this is linked to some updated documentation regarding scanning, which might help to adapt to the changed workflow (if this is not considered as a bug by the dev).

posts.name: Maydo7777
posts.cooked:
Hi Peer,

Thanks for finding the original PR! That’s very helpful.

You are right that the change is part of a new feature. However, this feature introduces a critical regression for the Pick List workflow.

In a Pick List, every item row is already assigned to a specific warehouse. The new logic (warehouse_match = !row[warehouse_field];) incorrectly assumes the warehouse field might be empty and fails every time because it’s always filled. This makes it impossible to scan any item.

Forcing users to scan a warehouse before every item in a Pick List would be a major step back in usability.

Therefore, this is a bug caused by an unintended side effect of the new feature. The change in my Pull Request fix(stock): Correct warehouse matching in barcode scanner by maydo7777 · Pull Request #49294 · frappe/erpnext · GitHub corrects this specific issue for the Pick List workflow while leaving the new “warehouse-first scanning” feature intact for other documents where it makes sense.
